entities.name: Query HldE-like protein
observations: 503 aa soluble bacterial enzyme candidate with estimated molecular mass 53.4 kDa and theoretical pI 6.21.
Shares 49.7–55.6% identity over 92.6–94.6% query coverage with reviewed HldE homologs Q1IJZ0, A0L7X0, and Q1H3A0.
Contains PfkB domain PF00294 at residues 32–325 and CTP_transf_like domain PF01467 at residues 370–483.
Most likely bifunctional enzyme in ADP-L-glycero-beta-D-manno-heptose biosynthesis; exact substrate specificity is inferred from homologs.

entities.name: HldE
observations: Bifunctional bacterial enzyme with heptose-7-phosphate kinase activity and heptose-1-phosphate adenylyltransferase activity.
Annotated reactions have EC 2.7.1.167 and EC 2.7.7.70 and participate in ADP-L-glycero-beta-D-manno-heptose biosynthesis.
Reviewed homologs are annotated as cytosolic homodimers.

entities.name: ADP-L-glycero-beta-D-manno-heptose biosynthesis
observations: HldE catalyzes two nonconsecutive steps: phosphorylation of heptose-7-phosphate at C1 and ADP transfer to heptose-1-phosphate.
The pathway contributes to bacterial nucleotide-sugar and lipopolysaccharide/core carbohydrate biosynthesis.
